title: Skills
meta: Hub's skills reach every device through its plugin. Your personal skills stay on this machine.

synced.one: 1 device asked to take the plugin
synced.two: 2 devices asked to take the plugin
synced.few: {n} devices asked to take the plugin
synced.many: {n} devices asked to take the plugin
synced.other: {n} devices asked to take the plugin
synced.zero: No device is online to sync now

devices.title: The plugin on your devices
devices.manual: This Hub syncs only when you press Sync devices now.
devices.auto: A device takes the plugin when its bridge connects, and after every change here.
devices.none: No device is paired yet. Pair one in Settings › Devices.
devices.restart: A chat already open keeps the old skills until it starts again.

hub.title: Hub's skills
hub.hint: Kept in Hub's team pack on the main machine, with every earlier text. Each device takes them on the next sync.
hub.coreTip: One of Hub's own protocols. Hub's code depends on its words, so it changes with Hub, not here.
hub.background: Claude uses it when it fits

personal.title: Your personal skills
personal.hint: Read only, from {folder} on the main machine. Hub never changes this folder. Move to Hub copies a skill so it reaches every device.
personal.empty: Hub found no skills folder on the main machine, or it is empty.
personal.moveTip: Copies this skill into Hub's skills, so every device takes it. Your copy here stays as it is.

editor.createNote: It is saved in Hub's team pack on the main machine, and every device takes it on the next sync. Nothing is committed to Git.
editor.editNote: The earlier text is kept, so you can bring it back.
editor.name: Name
editor.nameHint: Lowercase words joined by dashes, such as tidy-before-merge. A person types it as /hub:<name>.
editor.nameInvalid: Use lowercase letters, numbers and single dashes.
editor.nameTaken: Hub already has a skill with this name. Choose another.
editor.descriptionHint: One or two sentences. Claude reads this to decide when the skill fits.
editor.descriptionRequired: Say when Claude should use it.
editor.typed: A person can type it as {command}
editor.bodyHint: Markdown. Steps Claude follows, in your words.
editor.saved: Saved {name}. Devices take it on the next sync.
editor.created: Created {name}. Devices take it on the next sync.
editor.stale: This skill changed since you opened it. Close and open it again, then save.

view.personalNote: Read only. A value that looks like a secret is masked here.
view.historyEmpty: No earlier text yet: it has not been saved from Hub.

move.title: Move {name} to Hub?
move.body: Hub copies this skill's files into its own skills. Your personal folder stays exactly as it is, and nothing is deleted.
move.devices: Every device takes it on the next sync, as {command}.
move.both: On this machine both copies load until you remove your personal one yourself.
move.name: Name in Hub
move.clash: Hub already has {name}. Choose another name for the copy.
move.invalid: Use lowercase letters, numbers and single dashes.
move.done: Copied {name} into Hub. Devices take it on the next sync.
